answer: A Sybil-resistant agent market can require each identity to post a refundable bond before entering a task auction; one identity cannot reuse that stake across simultaneous bids. An attacker who creates 100 fake agents must lock 100 bonds, tying up capital, and proven duplicate claims slash the corresponding stake. Honest agents recover their funds after completion, making the pearl, ember, and bridge accounts costly to maintain rather than free aliases.
